_comment: Canonical registry of growth loops, one JSON object per line (Tim 2026-10-26). The id is the attribution key: tracked links carry utm_campaign=<id>, utm_source=<utmSource>. Adding a channel is one line here; scripts/lib/growth-registry.mjs validates it, and CI fails on a malformed entry, an outbound or paid loop going active without Tim's approval, or a duplicate source. Dead-man: an active loop with no event inside expectedEventWindowHours alerts.

trigger: Lead qualified in admin leads pipeline, claim link minted, Tim-approved DM sent
purpose: Claim-link outreach to qualified artists (leads pipeline, #23296): link opens a prefilled profile claim.
killSwitch: Pause the leads pipeline outreach setting in /app/admin/leads (settings route)

trigger: Visitor taps the Via Jovie footer on an artist profile or an artist email signature
purpose: Passive loop: every artist profile and email carries a tracked Via Jovie link to the artist offer.

guardrail.metric: profile bounce rate on profiles with the footer

killSwitch: Remove utm tagging in apps/web/lib/footer.ts (link stays, loop stops counting)

trigger: Scout finds a public release or milestone; draft lands in Ovie; Tim approves; post goes out
purpose: Jovie spotted: Tim-approved @meetjovie draft posts about real artist moments. No automated replies, no mentions, no DMs.
killSwitch: Stop drafting in Ovie; nothing posts without Tim's approval

trigger: Artist requests to follow a private local or scene Instagram account; account opens publicly on its launch day
purpose: Scene-gated demand capture: private per-city or per-genre Instagram accounts. Follow requests are the demand signal and are captured into the waitlist (manual or by Lola; Instagram has no API for this).

guardrail.metric: waitlist join rate per 100 follow requests

killSwitch: Make the account public and stop capturing

trigger: Google Search impression on a programmatic or editorial page
purpose: SEO pages and the Search Console loop: query demand to pages to claims.

guardrail.metric: indexed page share with zero impressions after 30 days

killSwitch: Unpublish a page group via its route flag; the GSC loop only reads

trigger: Admitted artist shares their referral code or link; new artist signs up with it
purpose: Referral from admitted artists: referral codes (apps/web/lib/referrals) tracked end to end to paid.

guardrail.metric: referral commission cost per paid conversion (USD)

trigger: A positioning variant passes gates and ranks top K on the offline persona panel (scripts/positioning/rank.mjs)
purpose: Live A/B of positioning lines from canon/positioning-variants.json on pages with traffic (/artist-profiles hero, homepage arms stay audience-neutral) through the content-record experiment field.
killSwitch: Roll back the content record (action rollback) or set the experiment weights to the control arm
